limits_to_record: No hard guarantee against MemoryError or an asynchronous exception arriving inside retention, description or attachment code itself, or between an origin and its first handler.
__context__ links are best-effort: Python rewrites the context when an exception is raised inside a handler (including the caller's). The attached prior tuple is the retention channel.
build_late_baseline retains internally but attaches no prior tuple; BaseExceptions propagate with Python's implicit context only.
No adversarial in-process authenticity: readers using getattr can be intercepted by subclass descriptors; CP1 reads the instance dict.
Pn_BASE_EXCEPTION evidence gains one 'retained at encounter: <type>' entry per retained object besides the described absorption entries.
